data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure in the right order (open Attractions & Tickets, pick the city, enter the keyword, search, sort, open a listing) with city, keyword and sort as parameters, but it never names the final action (Nearby or add to favorites) as a parameter and it limits sort to two options. A browser automation could still be built from it, though the post-open action and the choice of listing are underspecified.
